blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) has expanded its fuel marking operations to 10 revenue regions, testing 189 fuel stations as of Oct. 13, 2026, as part of its intensified enforcement against illicit fuel trade and efforts to protect the country’s revenue base. Of the stations subjected to field tests, 111 passed, and 78 failed, or 41.3 percent of all stations tested. Affected pumps were sealed from 78 establishments, with 900,250.69 liters of fuel inventory associated with failed field tests.
